# SCIP suite 10.0 — the paper's cited solver version. PySCIPOpt 6.2.1 is the
# binding that ships/links SCIP 10.0. Known-optimum F pins in tests assume it.
#
# Version self-check:
#   python -c "from pyscipopt import Model; print(Model().version())"  -> 10.0
PySCIPOpt==6.2.1

# Yices is the second solver, and its arithmetic decides artifact contents just
# as SCIP's does, so it is pinned too. Only the Python binding is a package:
# the matching libyices 2.7.0 shared library is built separately and reaches
# the process through SOLVER_LIB_PATH (see DEVIATIONS section 6).
#
# Version self-check:
#   python -c "import yices_api as y; y.yices_init(); print(y.yices_version)"
#     -> 2.7.0
yices==1.1.6
